name: TPWD Archery Upcoming Events + TPWD Calendar
feedUrl: https://tpwd.texas.gov/calendar/<park>/<event>/<date>/ics_view (per-event ICS seen in search index; a folder-level/search ICS is untested)
terms: Government site; no scraping restriction seen (unverified)
notes: Mostly park programs (Archery 101, Explore Bowhunting). Also lists the Texas NASP State Bullseye & 3D Tournament. Calendar is Plone-style with per-event ics_view. Filter to tournaments only, or most rows are classes. Fetch blocked from sandbox.

name: Texas 4-H district/county event calendars (AgriLife Extension)
notes: Pages titled 'Loading Events' point to WordPress The Events Calendar (e.g. 'Callahan County Archery Shoot'). Each district subsite (d24-h.tamu.edu, d54-h.tamu.edu, etc.) is separate; many district contests are only PDFs. Youth 4-H only. Not a priority.

name: Lone Star Bowhunters Association 3D shoots
notes: Newest indexed schedule is 2017 (forum posts). Looks inactive or not kept up. Skip.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
organization: (Oklahoma Triple Crown / SHOT the 3D Experience; Oklahoma NFAA chapter)
notes: OK events found: USA Archery OK state shoots (off-limits), Oklahoma Triple Crown 3D series (OKC Gun Club, Choctaw Archery, Crowder Lake), which seems to be promoted on social media only, and Total Archery Challenge at Beavers Bend (a single event, Apr 2026). No Oklahoma NFAA chapter site found. For chapter events, the best bet is NFAA find-an-event (see MULTI).

name: Peel Compton Foundation / The Quiver Archery Range events
notes: WordPress The Events Calendar ('Loading Events' pages). Hosts Full Draw 3D Tournaments (Apr 18 & Aug 23 2026) and USA Archery 3D Pin Series nights. Mostly classes, so filter on '3D'/'Tournament'. Only one venue in NW Arkansas.

name: Arkansas Bowhunters Association state shoots
notes: Runs an annual Fall State Championship / Bowhunter Bonanza at Camp Robinson SUA (Mayflower), plus a few others. Only a handful of events a year. Format unknown; enter by hand if at all.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found (LFAA via NFAA)
terms: Same 93ft platform as USA Archery; check terms/permission
notes: LFAA has no site of its own that I could find (contact lfaastateinfo@gmail.com). Its state Indoor/Field/3D/American 900 championships are posted as nfaausa.com/events/event-information/<id> pages. Bayou State Bowhunters Association only has old (2013) news items.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
organization: Mississippi Bowhunters Association / State Games of Mississippi
notes: Only one State Games 3D/field event a year (Camp Binachi, Meridian). No current MBA site found. Other MS events found were USA Archery (off-limits).

name: CMP Talladega Marksmanship Park monthly 3D archery tournaments
notes: Monthly 3D tournaments at Talladega. CMP's site is WordPress, so a tribe/REST events endpoint may exist; check https://thecmp.org/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events from an unblocked network.

name: Bowhunters of Alabama zone shoots
notes: Chapters in 3 zones hold periodic 3D shoots Feb-Oct. No official online schedule found before the search budget ran out. Many AL ASA federation clubs (St Clair, Lost Arrow, Elmore, Heritage) are listed on ASA's federation page.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found (GBAA via NFAA)
organization: Georgia Bowhunters & Archery Association (GBAA, NFAA chapter)
notes: GBAA posts its state tournaments on NFAA. Georgia Southern SSEC (recreation.georgiasouthern.edu/ssec) hosts GBAA State Indoor / NFAA SE Indoor Sectionals, but as news posts. GAPPS archery is school-only. Most other GA results are USA Archery (off-limits).

name: FWC Outreach Events Calendar (archery)
organization: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
notes: YourMembership-style calendar (EventDetails.aspx?id=). Lists the Monthly 3D Archery Shoot at Chinsegut Conservation Center, Brooksville (1st Saturday) plus other FWC archery events. YM calendars often have per-event iCal links; month view is calendar.asp?m=&y=. Needs a keyword filter for 'archery'.

name: Florida Archery Association (NFAA chapter) 3D/field season
notes: Active NFAA 3D season (Central Marked 3D, State Safari 3D, International State). Events are mirrored on nfaausa.com event pages. Own-site format not checked (fetch blocked); worth a manual look for a Google Calendar embed.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
organization: TN ASA Federation / TN S3DA / clubs
notes: Found only individual clubs (Twin Oaks Bowhunters, Chapmansboro; Wolf River Bowhunters, monthly Feb-Sep), TN S3DA regionals (S3DA is blocked), TWRA NASP state championship (one event), and UT 4-H PDFs. No state org calendar feed found.

name: KDFWR Calendar of Events (club 3D archery shoots)
organization: Kentucky Department of Fish & Wildlife Resources
notes: Best KY find. Clubs list their own 3D archery shoots here (e.g. Caldwell County Sportsman Club at Jones-Keeney WMA; Fern Creek Sportsman Club, Louisville). Each has a stable Detail.aspx?ID= page with venue, fees and dates. ASP.NET HTML, so a list/search page has to be parsed; filter titles on 'archery'/'3D'.

name: KSAA (NFAA chapter) / KyNASP / KY S3DA
organization: Kentucky State Archery Association; KDFWR NASP
notes: KSAA events (e.g. 3D Championship, May 2026) show up on NFAA. KyNASP 3D state qualifiers (Dec 2026-Feb 2027) go on nasptournaments.org (see MULTI). The KDFWR NASP newsletters are PDFs.

name: SCAA 3D Circuit (via NFAA event pages)
terms: NFAA 93ft platform, same vendor as USA Archery; confirm terms or get permission
notes: The SCAA 3D Circuit has many numbered shoots (e.g. #5 Midlands Archery Center, #7 Sandune Archery Club). Each is a separate NFAA event page. No SCAA site of its own found. SC BHA and the Keowee Bowhunter Jamboree (Aug 15 2026, Pickens Co) appear only on aggregators.

name: Three Rivers Land Trust events (Southern Archery Circuit stop at The Point, Mocksville)
notes: WordPress The Events Calendar with monthly 3D archery tournaments (20 targets) and an ASA tournament. The newest indexed events are 2022-2023, so check it is still active. Only one venue.

name: gunstuff.tv events (NC shooting events incl. NC ASA State Championship)
terms: Third-party media site; check terms before using
notes: Listed the 2026 NC ASA 3D Archery State Championship (Jul 18-19, Foothills Public Shooting Complex). Third-party re-listing, so coverage of archery is unknown and probably thin.

name: Southern Archery Circuit / NC 100 Archers
organization: Southern Archery Circuit (club circuit, NC); NC 100 Archers
notes: The SAC schedule (e.g. Juneberry Ridge, Norwood, Apr 26 2026; schedule updated 2/17/26) seems to be posted on Facebook. NC 100 Archers has an Odoo website page for outdoor 3D (HTML, format unchecked).

name: Virginia DWR Events (partner 3D shoots incl. ASA state qualifiers)
notes: WordPress site with an /events/<slug>/ post type (e.g. Split Nocks Archery 3D Shoot ASA State Qualifier, Powhatan, May 16 2026; DWR Archery Open, Jan 2026). Check for /wp-json/wp/v2/ events or an ICS export. Needs an archery keyword filter.

name: Virginia Bowhunters Association club 3D shoots
notes: VBA lists clubs and 3D shoots in its magazine. vabowhunters.org did not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND). Kingsboro Bowmen (Suffolk) charity 3D shoot found only on an aggregator.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found (WVAA via NFAA)
notes: WVAA State Indoor (Feb 28 2026, The Bow Shop, Clarksburg) was found. I could not find WVAA's own URL. WVDNR covers only the NASP state tournament (news releases).

name: NFAA Find an Event (state chapter events)
terms: Built on 93ft, the same platform/vendor as usarchery.org (whose terms ban scraping). Review NFAA terms or ask NFAA for permission/feed first.
notes: Biggest single source for this region. LFAA, FAA, GBAA, SCAA, KSAA, WVAA etc. post state shoots as /events/event-information/<id> pages with dates, host club and town. One integration would cover most chapters. Blocked from sandbox. May overlap with other regions' research.

name: NASP Tournaments (state NASP bullseye/3D + qualifiers)
organization: National Archery in the Schools Program
notes: Every state's NASP state tournaments and qualifiers (e.g. KyNASP 3D qualifiers, Texas NASP state at Freeman Coliseum) go on TournamentDetail.aspx?tid= pages. ASP.NET. Youth/school only. Blocked from sandbox.

name: ASA Federation club listings
terms: ASA: facts + link only, no copied text/logos
notes: Lists federation clubs by state (330+ clubs in 37 states). Some show events/state qualifiers. Would complement the existing ASA Pro/Am feed, but only as a club directory unless it lists dated events.

name: boisegunclub.com state event pages (NOT recommended)
notes: Shows archery events for every state (/<state>/events). Its sources and accuracy are unclear, so don't build on it. It is useful only for finding the original clubs.
